package.name: PartKinds
package.doc: PartKinds - the kinds of part def (spike8). One responsibility: how parts are classified (convention 1, Q20). A part def says its kind by specializing one of these abstract part defs: `part def Ad9208 :> HwPart`.

partDefs.name: HwPart
partDefs.doc: An external hardware part (master: HW Part Def).

partDefs.name: SystemPart
partDefs.doc: The top level (master: System Part Def, D10).

partDefs.name: Rtl
partDefs.doc: A leaf block in hand-written HDL: scaffolded once, then the designer's (2026-11-22).

partDefs.name: VendorIp
partDefs.doc: A wrapper around vendor IP (e.g. generated by Vivado) (2026-11-22).

partDefs.name: HardMacro
partDefs.doc: A hard block of the FPGA itself (transceiver, PLL, ...) (2026-11-22).

partDefs.name: RegisterFile
partDefs.doc: A register block described in SystemRDL (2026-11-22).
